dogecoin.text: Some more recently compromised @verified accounts peddling the Elon Musk cryptocurrency scams promoting $BTC $ETH $DOGE giveaways ahead of hosting @nbcsnl tonight. @rinkisethi @TwitterSafety @twittersecurity @elonmusk #dogecoin https://t.co/qb36FTi60t
@BryanGreenbaum @chamath Thanks Bryan. I've definitely noticed it before, but his appearance on SNL and the hype around $DOGE being talked about is what spurred this activity over the weekend.

TL;DR: Scammers were able to capitalize on @elonmusk's appearance by running scams on both Twitter and YouTube, netting just over $10 million in $BTC $ETH and $DOGE. https://t.co/DHyIKK7DZJ cc: @TwitterSafety  @rinkisethi @dotMudge @TeamYouTube

As a reminder, I published a report analyzing a number of scam campaigns that seized on @elonmusk hosting @nbcsnl from May 7-9. Those campaigns resulted in the theft of over $10 million in $BTC, $ETH and $DOGE at market prices for close of business May 9. https://t.co/DHyIKK7DZJ
